name: jd_worldwide_open-mcp
display_name: JD Worldwide (京东全球购) + JD Open Platform (宙斯) MCP
description: JD Worldwide (京东全球购) + JD Open Platform (宙斯) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product,

platform_mcp_jd_worldwide_open_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_WORLDWIDE_OPEN_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_jd_worldwide_open_app_key.description: app_key of your JD Open Platform (宙斯/JOS) app, https://jos.jd.com/.

platform_mcp_jd_worldwide_open_app_secre.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_WORLDWIDE_OPEN_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_jd_worldwide_open_app_secre.description: appSecret of the same app; signs every call: upper(MD5(appSecret + sorted name+value of all parameters + appSecret)). Never sent on the wire.

platform_mcp_jd_worldwide_open_access_to.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_WORLDWIDE_OPEN_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_jd_worldwide_open_access_to.description: The merchant's access_token from the JOS OAuth authorisation (https://jos.jd.com/commondoc?listId=32); renew it before it expires and update this value — the runtime does not refresh it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: jingdong.seller.vender.info.get: the authorised merchant's vender_id, shop_id and shop_name.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: jingdong.ware.read.searchWare4Valid: title keyword search over the AUTHORISED MERCHANT's own wares (JD's open platform is seller-side; 'not supported for JD self-operated stores'). `query` is required (the whole parameter set is omitted without it and JD returns its default first page); page size at most 50. `image_url` is a JD image path (prefix https://img10.360buyimg.com/n0/). Wares are SPUs; SKUs come from jingdong.sku.read.searchSkuList (not mapped).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: jingdong.ware.read.findWareById: one ware of the authorised merchant by wareId.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: jingdong.pop.order.get: an order RECEIVED by the authorised merchant. orderState: NOT_PAY, WAIT_SELLER_STOCK_OUT (等待出库), WAIT_GOODS_RECEIVE_CONFIRM, FINISHED_L, TRADE_CANCELED, …; `total` is orderPayment (amount paid, CNY); times are Beijing time; itemInfoList in `raw`.
